correctness.rationale: Reconstructed compact symbolic quotient and all eventual one-particle source-target pairs: p->any, isolated finite block->p, ascending step->p/descending step, descending->p/ascending. For any unbounded return sequence of F_n, compactness yields <=n endpoint arrows covering every source and target in A. Their two disjoint orientation classes require max(a,b) each, every isolated block forces two p arrows, and p requires an extra arrow exactly when c=0 and a=b. Explicit finite-block long bridges and translates realize every permitted directed arrow simultaneously with distinct initial/terminal representatives at arbitrarily long common times; fixed p handles self-loop. Independently computed exact minimum edge covers for all 53 nonempty a,b,c<=2,p in {0,1} combinations; n=1 and F2 boundaries align with Đorić Proposition 7. Finite DP is corroboration; all n follows the endpoint/arrow proof.
residual_risks: The proof assumes the exact countable quotient shift, and does not infer chain recurrence or polynomial entropy.

evidence: Earlier abstract-level transfer theorems are for generic continua and nonwandering-vs-fixed phenomena; Đorić gives existence examples and F2 characterization.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General nonwandering transfer conditions do not automatically imply exact minimal number of witnesses for arbitrary finite subsets of this quotient; no inspected stronger specific implication. 2012 inaccessible text is an explicit priority risk.
